summary: The configured default execution profile, the one agent work runs on when nothing more specific names one, was named, replaced or taken away by profile.set_default or profile.unset_default.

key.description: The setting the line is about, as the settings file spells its path: `Roles:DefaultExecutionProfile`.

old.description: The name of the profile that was the default in force before, or null where none was.

new.description: The name of the profile that is the default in force now, or null where it was taken away. A line is written only when it differs from the one before.
